headline_marked: [[At least 10 dead]] in Spain as two high-speed trains collide
headline: At least 10 dead in Spain as two high-speed trains collide
summary: Two high-speed trains collided in Spain, causing multiple carriages to derail and fall down an embankment. The death toll is expected to rise.
details: At least 10 people were killed and many more injured when two high-speed trains collided in Spain on Wednesday. The accident occurred on the line connecting Madrid to the southern Andalusia region.
Footage from the scene shows a derailed train with carriages strewn across an embankment. One train's carriage remained on an elevated section of track.
Passengers described hearing a "massive roar" and a "truly enormous thud" at the moment of impact. One passenger saw a "wrecked train" through the window.
Regional authorities confirmed 10 deaths but stated the number of casualties is expected to increase. A total of 147 people were travelling on one train and 397 on the other.
This is the second deadly accident on this line in less than a year. In January, a similar crash involving trains from the same operators killed 46 people.
The cause of the collision is not yet clear. Emergency services have been mobilized, and local authorities are preparing facilities to accommodate passengers and the injured.
caption:
At least 10 killed in a catastrophic high-speed train collision in Spain. The death toll is expected to rise.

At least 10 people were killed and many more injured when two high-speed trains collided in Spain on Wednesday. The accident occurred on the line connecting Madrid to the southern Andalusia region.

Footage from the scene shows a derailed train with carriages strewn across an embankment. One train's carriage remained on an elevated section of track.

Passengers described hearing a "massive roar" and a "truly enormous thud" at the moment of impact. One passenger saw a "wrecked train" through the window.

Regional authorities confirmed 10 deaths but stated the number of casualties is expected to increase. A total of 147 people were travelling on one train and 397 on the other.

This is the second deadly accident on this line in less than a year. In January, a similar crash involving trains from the same operators killed 46 people.

The cause of the collision is not yet clear. Emergency services have been mobilized, and local authorities are preparing facilities to accommodate passengers and the injured.
